releases.title: Edemly 1.0.2
releases.summary: Current local stable package with release pages, clearer download links, and update feed checks.
releases.description: This release is the active local package used to test the static release portal, installer links, and update metadata flow. It keeps the client update policy in client.json while release history lives in releases.json.
highlights: Added release history data for the static site.
Separated downloads from archived release history.
Prepared the catalog for future platforms.
changes: Published the current Velopack stable feed.
Added versioned installer and portable links for the supported Windows package.
Added product media to release details.
knownIssues: macOS and Linux packages are placeholders only.
Local placeholder binaries may be empty during layout testing.

releases.title: Edemly 1.0.0

releases.description: The first stable Windows baseline for the local update workflow. Versions older than this are kept as history only and are not offered on the download page.
highlights: Velopack feed connected to local nginx.
knownIssues: Portable archive was not retained in the public catalog.
